question: A triangular display stand is shaped like a right pyramid with equilateral triangle base of side 12 cm and height 10 cm. What is the volume of the stand?
solution:
**Given:**

Side of equilateral triangle = 12 cm

Height of pyramid = 10 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of equilateral triangle = (√3 ÷ 4) × side²

Volume of pyramid = (1 ÷ 3) × base area × height

**Calculation:**

⇒ Base area = (√3 ÷ 4) × 122&l
t;/sup>

⇒ Base area = (√3 ÷ 4) × 144

⇒ Base area = 36√3

⇒ Volume = (1 ÷ 3) × 36√3 × 10

⇒ Volume = 12 × 10 × √3

⇒ Volume = 120√3 = 207.8 cm3

**∴ The correct answer is 207.8 cm3.**
